question: A person walks 5 km west, then 12 km south, and finally 5 km east. How far is he from his starting point?
solution:
Given: A person walks 5 km west,

Then 12 km south,

And finally 5 km east.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf061de813a14e49bdef7ce393d793ef0770f8f1bf3b592a51185bb91fc0fcab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2896eb99ef786d27c94920cf0798bc3832380b635274d6b9962084f76ecbc02.png] 

So, he is 12 km from his starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
